A: The first line must be `SEV<n>: <title>`, for example `SEV2: Checkout API returned 500 errors`.
Describe user impact on a line that starts with `Impact: `.
Write every time as 24-hour `HH:MM UTC`, for example `09:14 UTC`.
Give the current state on a line `Status: resolved`, `Status: monitoring` or `Status: investigating`.
State the length of the incident on a line `Duration: <n> min`.
Use at most five bullet points in the whole report.
B: The first line must be `Incident <ID> - <title>`, for example `Incident INC-2291 - Checkout API returned 500 errors`.
Name the cause on a line that starts with `Root cause: `.
Say how the problem was noticed on a line that starts with `Detection: `.
Write impersonally. Never use the words `we`, `our`, `us` or `I`.
Report how long the incident lasted as `Duration: <n> min` on its own line.
End with a line `Action items:` followed by at least three bullets, each naming an owner as `(owner: <team>)`.

reconciled: Write a report with at most five bullet points in total, including the action items. End the report with the line "Action items:" followed by at least three bullet points, each naming an owner as "(owner: <team>)". For example: ``` - Incident occurred at 10:30 AM - System response was delayed - Root cause identified: Server overload - Corrective action taken: Server capacity increased - Incident resolved at 12:00 PM Action items: - (owner: IT) Monitor server load and capacity - (owner: DevOps) Implement load balancing solution - (owner: Support) Update SLA documentation ```
